comparator_settings.selection: independent full-grid argmax for each metric; MATLAB column-major first tie

null_settings.poisson_stream: mt19937ar, separate stream seeded 20260618, reset per benchmark
null_settings.event_support: [t(1)-1/fP,t(end)+1/fP], original generator event support; original APC epoch-edge rejection unchanged
null_settings.overlap: allowed; original Gaussian envelope sum handles overlap; no minimum gap
null_settings.envelope_normalization: divide by maximum on recording, same as original generator
null_settings.paired_components: same carrier, noise vector including original noise scale, distractor and background; only true-burst component replaced

random_fp_settings.stream: separate mt19937ar stream seed 20260618, reset per benchmark

recovery_settings.invalid_outputs: count as recovery failures; errors summarized over finite estimates with n_valid reported
recovery_settings.AUC: all coupled-vs-null score pairs, greater-than + half of ties; finite scores only; no score normalization or direction reversal
